workLog.detail: Read issue #4896 body and its sole comment through repository GitHub scripts. No linked issue or pull request required recursion. No existing PR existed, and claim_issue.py assigned rjmurillo.

On origin/main commit 57715aa9f, the documented command succeeded under native UTF-8 but failed under LC_ALL=C, PYTHONUTF8=0 with UnicodeDecodeError at find_related_adrs line 137. Priority P1 and a fix are merited because the ADR gate fails before producing evidence on Windows.

Added explicit UTF-8 reads for ADR and template text. ADR decode failures now return exit 1 with the exact file path and decoder error. Regenerated the Copilot CLI skill mirror. Removed the empty package marker from the hyphenated test directory so the changed-files mypy gate can type-check its tests.

Added positive, negative, and edge tests. The positive test simulates cp1252 as the platform default and fails when explicit UTF-8 is removed. The negative CLI test proves invalid UTF-8 produces no partial JSON and names the ADR path.

Separate GPT-5.6 Sol code-review agents received only the worktree diff before and after the mypy-gate repair. Both returned CLEAN. Independent evidence includes 64 passing targeted tests, Ruff and changed-files mypy clean, 51 of 51 pre-PR checks passed, canonical and generated scripts byte-identical, and text plus JSON runtime checks under an ASCII locale.
